title_zh: 把志愿档案项目首轮缩小为一箱照片

scenario.label_zh: 缩小志愿档案项目的首轮范围
scenario.goal_zh: 说明现有志愿能力不足以整理全部档案，并约定先为一箱照片做简要目录

context_zh: 英国地方历史志愿小组讨论居民捐来的多箱材料。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Harriet
sentences.text: Cataloguing the whole collection would be a huge endeavour for three volunteers.

sentences.speaker: Duncan
sentences.text: I know. These boxes seem endless, and we have not even opened the cupboard.

sentences.speaker: Harriet
sentences.text: As a local-history enthusiast, I want to read everything, but that will not get us a usable catalogue.

sentences.speaker: Duncan
sentences.text: Could we start with the single box of street photographs and record only the basic details?

sentences.speaker: Harriet
sentences.text: Yes: a reference number, any date written on the back, and a short description. Unknown dates can stay unknown.

sentences.speaker: Duncan
sentences.text: Agreed. We will finish that box before deciding whether to expand the project.

sentences.speaker: Harriet
sentences.text: I will bring the blank record sheets on Saturday. Let us leave the other boxes closed for now.

targets.sense_zh: 无穷无尽的；似乎没完没了的
